metadata.title: Colored Khovanov homology theories at prime roots of unity
metadata.abstract: We equip Khovanov's colored $\mathfrak{gl}(2)$-homology groups with a degree-2 derivation. Over a field of characteristic $p>2$, the derivation specializes to a $p$-nilpotent differential, which leads to a categorification of colored $\mathfrak{gl}(2)$-homology at a $2p$th root of unity.
metadata.comment: 23 pages, many figures and diagrams. Comments welcome!

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 素数单位根处的彩色 Khovanov 同调
analysis.workSummary: 给彩色 gl(2) 同调加入次数 2 导子，在特征 p>2 的域上形成 p-幂零微分，实现 2p 次单位根处的彩色同调范畴化。
analysis.breakthrough: 把导子结构用于正特征的单位根理论。
analysis.limitations: 域特征要求 p>2，单位根阶数与 p 绑定。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 GPT-5.6 Sol 用于校对稿件。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 GPT-5.6 Sol 用于校对稿件。
